reviewer: AI-assisted draft; not a human attestation
unit: source event loop, not recording or request

definitions.positive: Directly visible task action in a timestamped source frame.
definitions.negative: Reviewed sampled frame visibly lacks the task action; does not label unsampled time.
definitions.ambiguous: Occlusion, seated edge contact, transition or insufficient resolution prevents deciding.
definitions.loop_boundary: Discontinuous reset brackets; exclude crossing intervals from inference.

railway.task: Visible descent and established presence in track bed; platform presence alone is negative.
railway.remaining_sample_indices: 24 and 25 require full-resolution review of far-platform exit
railway.loop_boundary: No visible reset in 26 sampled frames; unsampled continuity unverified.

gate.task: Person visibly handles or manipulates gate area; opening, forced entry, authorization and criminal intent are separate unknowns.
gate.remaining_sample_indices: Repeated cycles retained under one event identity; require per-frame human confirmation.

evaluation_policy.geometry: Previously revised polygon is calibration-only. No held-out accuracy claim.
evaluation_policy.uncertainty: Never count ambiguous samples as negatives.
evaluation_policy.intent: Never infer criminal intent or unauthorized activity from visible manipulation.
evaluation_policy.independence: Repeated loops, prompt variants and repeated inference are correlated.
